morning5_start.name: Me
morning5_start.text: *Day five. The last day. The uniform feels comfortable now. Five days ago it was stiff, but now it fits. — Have I gotten used to this school, or to these people?*

morning5_start_2.name: Me
morning5_start_2.text: *There's a school event today. The final one. The moment I step into the classroom — signals come from three directions.*

morning5_seo_note_1.name: Me
morning5_seo_note_1.text: *There's a note on my desk. Seoyeon's handwriting. — 'Make some time this afternoon. I'll leave the rooftop unlocked. — Seoyeon'*

morning5_yuna_story_1.name: Me
morning5_yuna_story_1.text: *Passing by the literature club's display corner in the hallway — a short story is pinned to the bulletin board. Title: 'To the Person I Met in the Library.' It's Yuna's. — A story only the protagonist would recognize.*

morning5_dain_1.name: 다인(Dain)
morning5_dain_1.text: Hey! I signed you up as my partner for today's sports event!

morning5_dain_2.name: 다인(Dain)
morning5_dain_2.text: If you try to run, I'll seriously be mad?

morning5_end.name: Me
morning5_end.text: *It's a question, but it's a threat. — Classic Dain.*

hidden_homeroom_d5_check.name: Me
hidden_homeroom_d5_check.text: *Event prep time. Walking down the hallway — I pass the empty classroom. The door is open.*

hidden_homeroom_d5_1.name: Me
hidden_homeroom_d5_1.text: *The teacher is sitting at the desk. — Not a manuscript this time. She's holding an envelope. A brown envelope.*

hidden_homeroom_d5_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d5_2.text: The manuscript. — It's unfinished. But I wanted to give it to my first reader.

hidden_homeroom_d5_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d5_3.text: Haven't shown this to anyone in seven years. — I really shouldn't be doing this.

hidden_homeroom_d5_4.name: Me
hidden_homeroom_d5_4.text: Ma'am. I think you can stop saying that now.

hidden_homeroom_d5_5.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d5_5.text: ...Never thought I'd hear that from a student.

hidden_homeroom_d5_6.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d5_6.text: ...No book reports. — ...Actually, write me at least one line.

hidden_homeroom_d5_7.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d5_7.text: After you graduate — let's meet. Not as teacher and student. ...I really shouldn't. But just this once. One last time.

hidden_homeroom_d5_8.name: Me
hidden_homeroom_d5_8.text: *She turns away. Her long hair sways. — Today, her cardigan buttons are straight.*

hidden_homeroom_d5_freetalk.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d5_freetalk.text: *Last conversation with the homeroom teacher in the empty classroom.*
hidden_homeroom_d5_freetalk.context: Day 5. Last day. The teacher handed over her 7-year manuscript. A promise to meet after graduation.
hidden_homeroom_d5_freetalk.personality: The teacher is more honest than usual because it's the last time. Using her catchphrase for the final time.

hidden_nurse_d5_check.name: Me
hidden_nurse_d5_check.text: *Break during the event. Passing by the nurse's office.*

hidden_nurse_d5_1.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d5_1.text: Oh? {name}. — It's the last day. The last day of the event.

hidden_nurse_d5_2.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d5_2.text: Come visit after graduation. ...Or before that, if you're hurt.

hidden_nurse_d5_4.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d5_4.text: ...Ask me that after graduation. — I'll answer then.

hidden_nurse_d5_5.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d5_5.text: ...{name}. Want me to put on a bandage?

hidden_nurse_d5_6.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d5_6.text: I know. I just needed an excuse.

hidden_nurse_d5_7.name: Me
hidden_nurse_d5_7.text: *There's small writing on the bandage. 'After graduation, let's meet at a cafe instead of the nurse's office — ♥'*

hidden_nurse_d5_freetalk.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d5_freetalk.text: *Last conversation with the school nurse outside her office.*
hidden_nurse_d5_freetalk.context: Day 5. Last day. The nurse wrote a message on a bandage. A promise to meet after graduation.
hidden_nurse_d5_freetalk.personality: The nurse is less playful than usual. Waiting for the day when excuses aren't needed.
